top_signals.title: US to China Dry Bulk Vessels Jump
top_signals.summary: "During the first three quarters of 2026, US dry bulk shipments to China have grown 104% y/y, driven by a 176% y/y increase in the shipment of grains. Volumes between the two countries weakened in 2025 amid rising trade tensions and higher tariffs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.
